cohort: One hundred and four pregnant nulliparous women in their third trimesters of pregnancy referred to Semirom health care centers.
finding: All constructs of the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB)—attitude toward NVD, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control—were significantly correlated with the intention to choose normal vaginal delivery (NVD).
mod_finding: Upon telephone follow-up, 71.15% of participants had a normal vaginal delivery (NVD) and 28.14% had a cesarean delivery.
